probe.format_note: 16:9 landscape (1280x720, H.264, 25 fps), 95.56 s, 2389 frames. Audio: AAC HE-AACv2 stereo 44.1 kHz (volumedetect mean -19.2 dB, max -3.0 dB), so a real soundtrack is present; its content was not listened to and cut-to-beat alignment was not measured. The on-screen sentences suggest narration but this is not confirmed. The film ends on a held end card with no fade to black inside the clip.

rights_note: found by the owner on Pinterest with a style search (file «code animation motion design2.mp4»), given by the owner via Downloads/refrencee on 2026-11-03; origin not stated → plan mode ADAPT, never RECREATE
reference_name: توضیح تخت با کامیون و رابط

mode.why: third-party clip of unknown origin: borrow the motion language (camera orbits that join flat views, thumbnail-to-world push-ins, foreground wall wipes, an interface panel that stays while the world changes, a split frame that compares two worlds) and the mono-hue vector look only, never its trucks, cities, characters, labels, logo or story (owner note). It is a product explainer with characters and interface beats, which is EXPLAINER; a hook-problem-solution voiceover package may run as REEL and a pure software film as UI with the same grammar.

ignored.why: the subject (road freight software) and every drawn subject (trucks, flatbeds with cranes, roads, map, warehouses, silos, paper-stack canyon, overpass city, office worker, counter clerk, driver, tablet and phone screens) are the reference's content; never copied, setting and subjects come from the voice-over

the third-party mark and wordmark «ALLOTRAC» and its logo in the sky are another company's identity; never used. The same applies wherever the mark returns (43-52, 53.4-59.4, 62.9-65.2, 88-95.56 s). The film's own logo outro comes from the brand (router conflict order, item 5)

all English on-screen wording is content, never copied: «A», «B», «PLANNING», «ALLOCATION», «DISPATCH», «Allotrac has an integrated solution for you.», «hello.», «GET STARTED», «SIGN IN», «Submit», «ERP», «GPS», «POS», «Port Logistics», «Accounting Software», «Customised Delivery Docs», «No expensive hardware required», and on the end card «Book a demo today», «allotrac.com.au»

method: ffprobe; ffmpeg contact sheets fps=2 over the whole clip (16 sheets of 4x3, all viewed); scene detect gt(scene,0.3) found exactly 6 frames, all hard cuts: 37.4, 40.2, 42.44, 59.4, 73.76, 79.0; every other shot change was found by eye and is continuous or too similar in colour for the detector; dense sheets at fps=4-8 on 2.0-4.0, 8.8-11.8, 18.5-20.5, 24.4-26.4, 29.2-30.2, 34.2-36.2, 45.4-47.4, 51.8-53.8, 63.8-65.8, 74.6-76.6, 84.2-85.2, 85.6-88.6 and 89.4-91.4 s, all viewed; the six hard cuts themselves got no dense sheet (a straight cut needs none); audio level checked with volumedetect. Spans inside dense sheets are accurate to about ±0.15 s, spans read only from the fps=2 sheets to about ±0.3 s. Easing is judged from frame spacing, not measured from curves. Colours read by eye, not sampled.

shots.shot: side-on medium-wide of the main vehicle filling most of the frame, on a road band under a bright sky
shots.camera: tracking with the subject, which holds its place in frame; very slow drift and slight pull-back
shots.moves: road dashes and the far horizon stream past while the subject stays locked and only bobs slightly; clouds barely move
shots.easing: linear world stream, gentle linear drift
shots.composition: subject centred and large (about 85% of frame width), three horizontal bands: sky, horizon stripe, ground
shots.transition_out: continuous: the camera orbits up from side view to overhead, no cut (r1-s2)
shots.palette: white-to-cyan sky, ocean-blue body with a navy gradient cab, grey ground gradient, white cloud shapes
shots.built: code-native (flat vector shapes with linear gradients, three-band background, scrolling dashes)
shots.reusable: yes: open with the key object locked in frame while the world streams behind it; motion only, never the vehicle

shots.shot: overhead view of the same object on a blue road, with a hard cast shadow
shots.camera: 2.1-2.7 s orbit from side view to overhead, ease-in-out, the object staying near frame centre; the sky band becomes the top ground band; 2.7-3.85 s nearly locked, very slow pull-back
shots.moves: the object visibly turns in perspective during the orbit and its shadow swings under it; 2.7-3.85 s road dashes stream and pale shapes slide past at the frame edges
shots.easing: smooth ease-in-out on a fast 0.6 s orbit, then linear
shots.composition: wide horizontal road band across the frame, object upper left of centre, pale empty ground above and below
shots.transition_out: continuous: fast pull-back to a map scale (r1-s3), no cut
shots.palette: ocean-blue road fading to dark navy on the left, white and pale-blue roof, near-white ground
shots.built: code-native real 3D (three.js camera orbit around a box-built object, a directional light for the hard shadow), or a 2.5D sprite swap for the object if the orbit stays under 0.6 s
shots.reusable: yes: an orbit from side view to overhead turns one flat shot into a map view without a cut; motion only

shots.shot: top-down schematic map: one road between two blocks, branches growing out of it, over pale ground with faint shapes
shots.camera: 3.85-4.2 s fast pull-back, ease-out; then a slow steady drift to the end of the shot
shots.moves: 4.2-5.5 s the two end blocks settle from flat squares into isometric cubes with a side face and a cast shadow, letters fade on them; 6.25-8.5 s four branches grow out of the main road one after another at about 0.6-0.75 s stagger, each drawn along its own centre line (some straight, one curved) with its label appearing along the line; small vehicles appear on each branch; the main object drives along the road and turns onto a branch at about 8.0 s
shots.easing: branches grow smooth ease-out with no overshoot, labels fade in 0.3 s
shots.composition: the main road is a horizontal spine at mid height with two heavy anchors at its ends; branches radiate up and down into calm space, labels run along the branches
shots.text: single letters on the blocks and short uppercase labels set along the branches (English, content ignored)
shots.transition_out: continuous: push-in follows the object to a tighter view (r1-s4)
shots.palette: saturated ocean-blue roads, cyan blocks with navy side faces, near-white ground, pale grey and pale-cyan background shapes
shots.built: code-native (SVG paths with stroke-dashoffset for the growing branches, text on a path, CSS or three.js cubes)
shots.reusable: yes: a process map that draws itself branch by branch, a label on each branch; the strongest teaching beat of the film; motion only, never the roads

shots.shot: tight overhead of the object travelling up the frame in a vertical road band
shots.camera: 9.0-9.8 s push-in toward the object, smooth ease-in-out; 9.8-11.2 s follow move, object locked in frame
shots.moves: pale background shapes stream down past the road at a different speed from the road (parallax); cast shadow stays on one side
shots.easing: smooth ease-in-out on the push, then linear stream
shots.composition: vertical band a little left of centre, the rest of the frame near-empty pale ground; already a portrait-friendly layout
shots.transition_out: continuous: the camera orbits down from overhead to behind the object (r1-s5), no cut
shots.palette: ocean-blue band, navy shadow, white roof, near-white ground
shots.built: code-native (top-down box object, CSS or three.js, scrolling plane)
shots.reusable: yes: follow the subject in a vertical band, which suits 9:16 directly; motion only

shots.shot: low rear view of the object driving down a narrow canyon of tall stacked forms, with loose thin sheets falling and swirling
shots.camera: 11.2-11.6 s orbit from overhead to rear view, ease-in-out, background darkening from white to deep navy as it turns; then a follow move with the object held centre
shots.moves: the tall stacks rush toward and past the camera on both sides in strong one-point perspective and sway slightly; small sheets flutter across the frame; the object keeps its place with its lights glowing
shots.easing: fast 0.4 s orbit, then steady linear rush
shots.composition: centred one-point perspective, object on the vanishing axis, walls of stacks on both sides, road wedge at the bottom
shots.transition_out: continuous: the walls fall away and the object enters a dark arch (r1-s6)
shots.palette: deep navy, ocean-blue object and road, pale grey-white stacks with cool shading
shots.built: code-native real 3D (three.js box stacks with a paper-edge texture, instanced thin planes for the sheets, fog for distance)
shots.reusable: yes: drive through a corridor made of the problem itself, so the burden becomes a place; motion only, the stacks are the reference's subject

shots.shot: dark arch closing around the object, which fades into black
shots.camera: locked rear view with a slow push toward the arch
shots.moves: 14.4-15.0 s the arch surrounds the object, glow from behind it weakens; 15.0-15.5 s the object fades to near black; about 0.5 s of black at 15.5-16.0 s
shots.easing: slow fade, about 1 s, linear
shots.composition: centred, arch framing the object
shots.transition_out: fade through black into r1-s7; the only black beat in the film
shots.palette: near-black navy with a soft blue radial glow
shots.built: code-native (radial gradient, arch shape, opacity fade)
shots.reusable: yes: a tunnel into black works as a silent reset before the answer; motion only

shots.shot: a glowing line-art mark rises at the centre of a dark void with a wordmark under it, on a dim floor plane
shots.camera: 16.0-18.5 s slow push with slight lateral drift; 18.8-19.7 s accelerating push until the mark flies past the lens
shots.moves: 16.0-16.5 s the mark comes up small and rotated, then scales to full size; the wordmark types on letter by letter with a soft fade, 16.5-17.5 s; thin vertical light bars with bright square caps rise and fall in the background and small particles drift
shots.easing: scale-up ease-out; final push accelerates (ease-in), with a white flash of the mark's strokes as it leaves the frame
shots.composition: centred mark over wordmark, floor wedge at the bottom, empty dark space around
shots.transition_out: continuous: push through the mark, its strokes pass the lens and reveal the next scene behind (r1-s8)
shots.palette: near-black navy, cyan-white glowing strokes with bloom
shots.built: code-native (SVG strokes with a glow filter, staggered letter fade, scale transform)
shots.reusable: yes: fly through a glowing line symbol to enter the next scene; motion only, the mark itself is never used, and the brand's own logo rules decide whether the film's mark may be used this way

shots.shot: low wide angle from a road looking up at a stylised skyline with a rising overpass, the object driving away down the centre
shots.camera: 19.7-20.0 s the object rises into frame from the bottom while still in the dark; 20.0-20.5 s the arch opens outward like an iris and reveals the bright scene; then a slow lateral drift
shots.moves: the object shrinks steadily toward the vanishing point, from about 30% to about 8% of frame width; smaller vehicles cross on the overpass and at both road edges; soft lens-flare discs slide across; distant skyline layers parallax
shots.easing: iris ease-out about 0.5 s; object shrink linear
shots.composition: strong diagonal of the overpass across the upper half, tall buildings at the frame edges, object on the centre axis, mark floating in the empty sky
shots.text: none apart from the third-party mark in the sky (ignored)
shots.transition_out: foreground wipe: a dark ribbed wall enters from the right and crosses the frame (r1-s9), 25.0-26.0 s
shots.palette: pale cyan sky fading to white at the horizon, ocean-blue and navy gradient buildings, lens discs in soft white
shots.built: code-native (layered SVG planes with parallax or three.js boxes with gradients, lens-flare discs as translucent circles)
shots.reusable: yes: an arch opening like an iris from a dark scene to a bright one, and a subject receding to show scale; motion only, never the skyline

shots.shot: side profile of a seated character at a desk facing a screen seen edge-on, in a dark interior with a window grid
shots.camera: 25.0-26.0 s lateral truck to the right past a near wall, which acts as the wipe; 26.0-29.9 s slow leftward drift
shots.moves: thin horizontal light tracers with bright heads cross the frame and pass over the character; screen edge glows with a soft white bloom; a hand lifts from the keyboard at about 27.5 s and returns; blink and small head changes
shots.easing: wall wipe smooth ease-in-out, 1 s; tracers linear; arm pose tween about 0.4 s
shots.composition: character slightly left of centre, screen on the right, dark margins on both sides, foreground furniture at the edges for depth
shots.transition_out: continuous: the whole set orbits around the character to a rear three-quarter view (r1-s10), no cut
shots.palette: near-black to ocean-blue interior, pale periwinkle shirt, warm peach skin as the single warm note, white screen glow
shots.built: code-native (cut-out SVG character in parts, a few pose tweens, blink; gradient planes; blurred white circle for the glow)
shots.reusable: yes: light tracers passing through a held character keep a calm frame alive; a foreground wall as a cut; motion only

shots.shot: over-the-shoulder rear three-quarter of the character at a large bright screen, interface panels opening out of it

shots.transition_out: continuous: very fast push into the map thumbnail, which fills the frame (r1-s11), about 34.95-35.25 s, no cut
shots.palette: dark navy room, white screen, translucent cyan glass panels, ocean-blue pie segments, peach skin

shots.shot: tilted top-down illustrated map held full frame, with small vehicles spread across it
shots.camera: enters by the thumbnail push (scale about 4x in 0.3 s); then almost locked with a very slow push and slight rotation
shots.moves: vehicles creep along very slowly; soft shadow shapes drift; the scene is close to a held picture

shots.composition: objects scattered across a diagonal river-like band, tilted so that no edge is parallel to the frame
shots.transition_out: hard cut at 37.4 s
shots.palette: pale periwinkle-white ground, ocean-blue band fading to grey, navy details, white vehicles

shots.shot: a standing character in profile at a counter using a tablet, shelves and hanging lamps behind

shots.moves: arm raises and taps the tablet (37.5-38.5 s); a tall translucent form panel rises from the bottom edge at frame right, 38.5-39.0 s, its lines then fading in; hand returns to the tablet

shots.composition: character left of centre, counter as a dark horizontal mass, tall panel fills the right third
shots.text: illegible form lines and a small button label (English, ignored)
shots.transition_out: hard cut at 40.2 s
shots.palette: ocean-blue to navy wall, pale periwinkle top, peach skin, translucent cyan panel

shots.reusable: yes: a tap on a small device calls up a tall glass panel beside the character; a tall panel is a natural fit for 9:16; motion only

shots.shot: two machines with articulated arms lifting loads, one small and far, one large and near
shots.camera: slow push and slight drift
shots.moves: articulated arms pivot joint by joint and lower their loads onto the beds; loads swing a little; a light speed streak at frame right

shots.composition: two subjects of different scale face each other, leaving a calm centre column; wide bright background
shots.transition_out: hard cut at 42.44 s
shots.palette: white-to-pale-cyan sky, ocean-blue and navy gradient machines, grey and white loads

shots.text: small third-party wordmark in the window (ignored)

shots.palette: deep blue field with a pale radial glow, cyan-white glass, ocean-blue squares and objects

shots.shot: pan across the empty blue field with one object travelling, arriving at a round glowing platform

shots.shot: high three-quarter view of three objects circling a central column of light on a round dark platform, with a mark floating in the light

shots.moves: the three objects orbit the centre at a constant slow speed, each turning in true 3D; thin rings and arcs with bright square ticks counter-rotate around the disc; from 54.5 s one floating icon card joins each object, entering edge-on then opening to full width, and they swap depth order as they circle

visual_language: Mono-hue vector explainer on one blue. Medium: 2D vector illustration with linear and radial gradients, soft glows and glass panels, mixed with simple toon-shaded 3D for the moves that need a real turn (orbits, the circling platform). Characters are slim flat figures with peach skin, cut-out proportions and quite rich hand acting in the close shots. Typography: a light regular-weight geometric sans used rarely: short labels along paths, one headline, one two-line sentence, then the end card; most of the film has no readable text at all and carries meaning through picture and icons. Rhythm: 26 shots in 95.56 s (average about 3.7 s, range 1.4-9.0 s), and only 6 hard cuts (37.4, 40.2, 42.44, 59.4, 73.76, 79.0 s); of the other 19 joins, one is a fade through black (r1-s6 into r1-s7) and 18 are continuous: camera orbits, push-ins, foreground wipes, tilts, or an element that stays while the world changes. Whether the cuts fall on a beat was not measured. Moves are smooth and confident: orbits and wipes ease-in-out at 0.4-1.0 s, entrances ease-out at 0.3-0.5 s with a small settle, only badges and small dots overshoot, world streams and tracers linear. Holds stay alive through slow camera drift and background activity (tracers, rising bars, floating squares). Palette: deep navy, ocean blue, sky blue, cyan-white and white, with peach skin as the only warm colour. Signature moments: a map that draws itself branch by branch; a thumbnail on a screen that becomes the next full-frame world; a corridor made of stacks; several objects orbiting a light column; a phone panel gathering cards that open like doors; the split frame with the same object in a blue and a grey world; a dark object switched on by a wave of light.
look: 2.5D with real 3D moments: flat vector shapes with clean gradients for almost everything, staged in layered planes, plus true perspective on the main objects (the camera really orbits them, and they really turn on the platform), isometric cubes and rounded bevelled tiles. Light and shadow: hard, offset, darker-blue cast shadows on the map and overhead views; soft blurred shadow on the painted-feel map; strong additive bloom on light sources in the dark scenes (column, screen, headlights, mark). Materials: glass panels (translucent cyan-white, background blur, thin bright edge), matte gradient bodies, and dark glossy tiles. Depth of field and blur: no lens blur on subjects; only faint soft-focus lens discs and blurred light glows. Backgrounds alternate between near-white daylight (map, sky, split panel) and a deep navy radial field with floating squares, dots and rising light bars; the light-dark alternation is itself part of the rhythm.
code_translation: Mixed build, never flattened where it turns. Real 3D in three.js for the moves that depend on it: orbits from side to overhead to rear view (r1-s2, r1-s5, r1-s25), the corridor (r1-s5), the platform with circling objects (r1-s17), the switched-on object (r1-s24); the material is a toon or gradient-ramp shader with no realistic reflections, a directional light for hard shadows, additive sprites for bloom. Everything else in SVG or HTML layers inside one camera group: gradient planes with parallax factors per plane, cut-out characters with pose tweens and blink, glass panels with backdrop-filter and a bright 1 px edge, cards that open with CSS rotateY from edge-on, process maps with stroke-dashoffset growth and text on a path, a thumbnail push with a 0.3 s scale of about 4x on a shared group, wipes by a large foreground plane moving across the frame, split frames as two clipped copies of one scene, an iris as an expanding clip-path arch. Ambient layer shared across scenes: vertical light bars with bright caps, floating squares, dots and horizontal tracers; keeping it mounted across a scene change is what makes tilts seamless. Reference colours are mapped onto brand colour roles (world dark, world mid, surface light, glowing accent, warm accent), never used as literal hex values; the one-hue idea stays, with the hue coming from the brand.
continuity: Camera orbit as the join: one subject stays near frame centre while the view swings from side to overhead or from overhead to rear, and the background bands become a different kind of space.
Self-drawing map: one spine, branches growing out one by one with a label running along each; pull back to reveal it, push in to leave it.
Thumbnail becomes the world: a small picture on a screen is pushed into at speed until it fills the frame and is the next scene.
Foreground wall wipe: a large near plane crosses the lens while the camera trucks sideways; the next set is already standing behind it.
Fly through a line symbol: push through a glowing outline until its strokes pass the lens and the next scene is behind it.
Arch iris: a dark opening around the subject swells outward and reveals the bright next scene.
Anchor stays, world leaves: one element (an interface panel, a symbol) holds its exact place while everything around it slides or sinks away and a new background arrives.
Shared ambient layer: rising light bars and floating squares keep running across a tilt, so the eye treats two scenes as one space.
Rise-and-sink tilts: the outgoing scene leaves through the top or bottom while the next one rises from the opposite edge.
Glass overlap: an interface panel overlaps a real object and tints it, then pieces move across the overlap, joining the abstract and the physical in one frame.
Parts circling a core: several elements keep orbiting one light column, each one picks up its own card and they swap depth as they pass.
Split into two worlds: a second copy of the same shot rises from the bottom edge in a different colour world, aligned with the first.
Wave of light: a dark object lights up by a passing wave and the world's lines ignite with it, turning a state change into one moment.
Light tracers through a held shot: thin horizontal streaks pass over a character or object, tying people and things to the same data flow.
risks: Third-party film of unknown origin: ADAPT only. Never copy its subjects (trucks, road network, paper-stack canyon, overpass city, office worker, clerk, driver, cranes), its freight-software story, its logo, its interface labels or its sentences; only the camera grammar, continuity devices, timing and the mono-hue rendering style.

Source is 16:9 (1280x720); the film is usually 9:16. Already vertical or stacked: r1-s4, r1-s12 panel, r1-s17, r1-s19, r1-s21, r1-s25, r1-s26. Wide frames must be recomposed: the map spine r1-s3 turns vertical, side-on tracking r1-s1 and r1-s20 need a shorter subject or a tighter crop, r1-s15's diagonal goes top to bottom, and the lateral wall wipe r1-s9 still works but its truck covers less distance.

The source is left to right throughout (labels, list order, cursor, panels at right). Under the skill's RTL grammar, order and entry directions are mirrored where direction carries meaning; labels are Persian.

The reference has little text: Persian on-screen text must be added in calm areas (panel surfaces, empty field, sky), held long enough to read and kept in the safe zone. Text along a curved road or path (r1-s3) can break Persian joins or legibility; use straight horizontal labels beside the branch unless a test render proves the join is clean. The per-letter wordmark fade (r1-s7, r1-s26) must never be applied to Persian; animate whole lines or words.

Character acting in r1-s18 and the hands in r1-s22 are close to frame-by-frame in the source; in code keep characters to a few cut-out pose tweens, blinks and slides. Expect a visible drop against the source in these shots if they run long; avoid turnarounds and full walk cycles.

The 3D moments (r1-s2, r1-s5, r1-s17, r1-s24, r1-s25) need a toon-shaded 3D model of each main subject, and the subject comes from the voice-over; a subject too complex to model simply should use a shorter orbit with a 2.5D sprite swap, recorded in plan.md as a deviation.

The peach skin is the source's only warm colour; it and every source blue are mapped to brand-safe roles, and banned brand colours are never used even where the reference has an equivalent. Mono-hue blue applies only if the brand's roles allow it; otherwise the single-hue idea is kept in the brand's own main hue.

The logo moves (fly through the symbol, r1-s7; mark in the sky, r1-s8; end card, r1-s26) touch brand identity: the brand's own logo rules and logo outro win; these are offered only where the brand permits them.

95.56 s is long and has several self-contained sections; a short reel should choose a subset of the patterns rather than compress all 26 shots. The shot rhythm (average 3.7 s) is calm, so hook seconds may need tighter joins, and that choice is recorded in plan.md.
The audio track was not listened to and cut-to-beat alignment was not measured, so L6 builds sound from the storyboard and voice timing places every cut.

Colours and easing were read by eye from contact sheets, and spans outside the dense sheets are about ±0.3 s; shot boundaries other than the 6 detected hard cuts were placed by eye. Any move copied exactly should be checked against the clip first.
code_buildable_note: 95.56 of 95.56 s by the rule that 3D renders count as buildable and only live footage, real photos or faces and painted illustration do not: the clip has none of these (the map in r1-s11 has a painted feel but is plain vector shapes with soft shadows). This is a statement about the kind of material, not about parity: the finer hand acting in r1-s18 and r1-s22 is reduced to pose tweens in code, and the 3D shots need a modelled subject.
